Now, we integrate the velocity to get [MATH: x(t)\mathbin{:}]

To determine [MATH: K,] we use the fact that [MATH: x(1) = 1.] Substituting this into the above gives

[MATH: 1|= (1)/(2)(1)^{2} − (1)/(3)(1)^{3} + 2(1) + K; K|= − (7)/(6).]

Therefore, the position [MATH: x] of the particle at time [MATH: t] is

[MATH: x(t) = \dfrac{1}{2}t^2-\dfrac{1}{3}t^3 +2t -\dfrac{7}{6}.]
